frames.label: gesture_1
frames.description: Neutral frontal standing, hands at sides, glance toward screen-right. Both feet fixed on ground.

frames.label: gesture_2
frames.description: Right elbow begins bending, right hand rises slightly away from thigh, palm loosening. Both feet fixed on ground.

frames.label: gesture_3
frames.description: Right forearm lifts to waist height, palm begins turning upward, gaze toward empty space screen-right. Both feet fixed on ground.

frames.label: gesture_4
frames.description: Use the SAME open presenting palm on LEFT SIDE OF IMAGE as the reference, her anatomical right, NO watch. Extend that SAME hand only 5cm further toward LEFT EDGE OF IMAGE at waist height, palm still up. Her watch arm on image right remains DOWN. No swapping arms.

frames.label: gesture_5
frames.description: Right arm extends a little farther, open palm up at lower chest height, presenting imaginary content screen-right; no actual objects. Both feet fixed on ground.

frames.label: gesture_6
frames.description: Keep exactly this open-palm presentation gesture using the SAME non-watch arm on LEFT SIDE OF IMAGE. Lift the SAME palm by only 3cm, fingers relaxed open, friendly smile. Watch arm on image right remains DOWN.

frames.label: gesture_7
frames.description: Keep exactly this open-palm presentation gesture using the SAME non-watch arm on LEFT SIDE OF IMAGE. Settle the SAME palm by only 2cm, fingers relaxed open, head gently turns 2 degrees toward visitor. Watch arm on image right remains DOWN.

frames.description: Neutral frontal standing, thoughtful eyes glance upward-left, mouth gently closed. Left arm relaxed at side, feet fixed.

frames.label: reaction_2
frames.description: Right hand begins rising from side toward chest, elbow gently bends, eyebrows subtly lift. Left arm relaxed at side, feet fixed.

frames.label: reaction_3
frames.description: Right hand at sternum, index finger relaxed upward, gaze stays upward-left. Left arm relaxed at side, feet fixed.

frames.label: reaction_4
frames.description: Right hand lifts below chin, index finger approaches chin, expression curious. Left arm relaxed at side, feet fixed.

frames.label: reaction_5
frames.description: Right index finger gently touches chin, other fingers curled naturally, head tilts 5 degrees left. Left arm relaxed at side, feet fixed.

frames.label: reaction_6
frames.description: Same hand-on-chin pose, brows gently knit in concentration, eyelids slightly narrower, subtle 2-degree head tilt. Left arm relaxed at side, feet fixed.

frames.label: reaction_7
frames.description: Keep the SAME non-watch hand touching the chin in exactly this thinking pose. Change only subtly relaxing the eyebrows, 2 degree head leveling and tiny knowing smile. Do NOT lower hand. Both feet unchanged.

frames.label: reaction_1

frames.label: reaction_2

frames.label: reaction_3

frames.label: reaction_4

frames.label: reaction_5
frames.description: Both hands at chest height in restrained celebratory gesture, broad friendly smile, eyes bright, no jump.

frames.label: reaction_6
frames.description: Same celebration, eyes briefly close in delighted smile, fists lift just 2cm, head gently tilts.

frames.label: reaction_7
frames.description: Keep BOTH happy loosely curled fists AT CHEST HEIGHT exactly as reference, elbows bent. Change only OPENING BOTH EYES and lowering fists by 2cm with a warm satisfied smile. Do NOT drop arms to sides. Both feet unchanged.
